name: conclave
description: A tri-vendor review panel: one seat builds, two check it, and the votes are counted in code.

conclave.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to `mcp/server.js` in a CONCLAVE checkout. Empty uses a checkout in this workspace if there is one, and the published `conclave-mcp` package otherwise. A path that is set and not there is an error, never a fall back to a different server.

conclave.rulesOnly.markdownDescription: Serve only the six tools that answer from JSON — read a block, route it, read a reply, count a panel — and refuse the four that drive a run. For an editor that reads verdicts rather than convening panels.
